stdout '^--- a/range\.go$'

! exists range.lgo
cmp range.go $WORK/range.go.orig
cmp neg.go $WORK/neg.go.orig

logos next --fix
stdout 'tasks in next_tasks.json'
exists next_tasks.json
exists range.lgo
exists neg.lgo
! exists range.go
! exists neg.go

cmp neg.lgo $WORK/neg.go.orig

grep 'ys := xs\.map' range.lgo
! grep 'for ' range.lgo
grep 'for .*range' neg.lgo

grep -count=4 '"category": "ai-patch"' next_tasks.json
grep -count=4 '"rule": "loop-chain"' next_tasks.json
grep 'func breakOut\(xs \[\]int, limit int\) \[\]int' next_tasks.json
grep 'func countSide\(xs \[\]int\) \(int, \[\]int\)' next_tasks.json
grep 'func useIndex\(xs \[\]int\) \[\]int' next_tasks.json
grep 'func twoSlices\(xs, zs \[\]int\) \[\]int' next_tasks.json

logos build ./...
logos run .

-- m/range.go --
// Range rewrites to map chains.
package main

import "fmt"

// double doubles n.
func double(n int) int {
	return n * 2
}

// doubleAllIdx doubles every element over an index range.
func doubleAllIdx(xs []int) []int {
	var ys []int
	for i := range xs {
		ys = append(ys, double(xs[i]))
	}
	return ys
}

// doubleAllVal doubles every element over a value range.
func doubleAllVal(xs []int) []int {
	var ys []int
	for _, x := range xs {
		ys = append(ys, double(x))
	}
	return ys
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(doubleAllIdx([]int{1, 2, 3}), "idx")
	fmt.Println(doubleAllVal([]int{1, 2, 3}), "val")
	fmt.Println(breakOut([]int{1, 5, 2}, 3))
	fmt.Println(countSide([]int{-1, 2}))
	fmt.Println(useIndex([]int{0, 1, 2}))
	fmt.Println(twoSlices([]int{1, 2}, []int{10, 20}))
}

-- m/neg.go --
// Loops left for manual rewrite.
package main

// breakOut collects elements up to the limit.
func breakOut(xs []int, limit int) []int {
	var out []int
	for i := range xs {
		if xs[i] > limit {
			break
		}
		out = append(out, xs[i])
	}
	return out
}

// countSide counts and collects elements.
func countSide(xs []int) (int, []int) {
	var out []int
	n := 0
	for _, x := range xs {
		n++
		out = append(out, x)
	}
	return n, out
}

// useIndex adds each element to its index.
func useIndex(xs []int) []int {
	var out []int
	for i := range xs {
		out = append(out, xs[i]+i)
	}
	return out
}

// twoSlices adds pairs from two slices.
func twoSlices(xs, zs []int) []int {
	var out []int
	for i := range xs {
		out = append(out, xs[i]+zs[i])
	}
	return out
}
